title: Rebuild from a newer CV as a field-level merge that keeps your edits
deviations_from_card: Case 7 is the critic's pure view-model rebuildDialogModel(plan) (the revision). Two extra pure tests beyond the 7: planRebuildFromPayloads maps through the one formStateFrom, and every form field has a label key that exists in the profile catalog. The baseline is served by a new store read profileSourceAnalysisSlug(id, ws) (workspace-scoped) rather than widening getProfileRecord, whose row the GET serializes verbatim. openRebuild still skips planning when the profile never diverged (the timestamp says no hand edit exists), so an unedited rebuild behaves exactly as before; planning runs only for diverged profiles. 'Keep my version' opens a plain edit (the profile stays stale), as the old Keep did. The five retired rebuildWarn* catalog keys were removed in a separate catalog commit after the UI stopped reading them. formStateFrom is exported from useProfileEditorFields.ts (no move); the hook gains one optional seed argument and a draftOrigin return field, nothing else - r04 profile-editor inherits a clean hook. profileDraftMerge.ts is untouched: its private comparison is reused via mergeDraft(a,b,b).kept.
notes: Full npm run test:unit exited 1 on ONE file, app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts ('an aborted spawn kills the whole process tree'), labelled FLAKE (failed, then passed on re-run) - unrelated to this card; 9867/9868 otherwise. tsc: clean on the tracked tree; the only errors come from the untracked kpi-sim/runs/**/main-tree copy (foreign, not in git). test:perf/perf:budget: app/page.tsx raised 8669 -> 8681 KB by this card's share only (+11.8 KB net across the profile folder's non-test files, module count unchanged at 1385) in 060ddba4d; remaining overages are job-ingest.ts 402/400 (the known line) and app/api/jds/generate/route.ts 3024/3023 - profiles.ts is not on that route's graph (perf:budget --explain), so that line is a sibling's. Commit order was catalogs(add) -> test+pure+store/route -> perf -> UI -> catalogs(retire) -> doc so every commit type-checks.
